user.title: Kindle Panel
user.description: Which Music Assistant connection should the panel use for full play queues?

abort.single_instance_allowed: Kindle Panel is already set up.

data_description.names_he: Hebrew for names that have no row of their own (the room labels of lights, the amplifier and TV, ...), one per line (YAML), e.g. 'Dining room: פינת אוכל'. Lights, rooms, plugs, scene buttons, custom tabs and their toggles have a Hebrew name field in their own rows.
data_description.tabs: Order and presence of the tabs on the panel (at most 6). Custom tabs are created under Custom tabs; a tab removed here keeps its setup and can be added again.

data.scenes: Scene buttons (in screen order: F1, F2, F3)

data_description.scenes: Up to 3 buttons on the Lights tab (F4 stays 'All off'). Each runs an HA scene or script, or a built-in scene: Bright (every light on, 100 %) or Evening (the light below dimmed and warm, the others off). The names Bright, Evening and Movie show in Hebrew by themselves; other names take their Hebrew from General → Hebrew names.
data_description.evening_light: Only used by a built-in Evening button.

data_description.plugs: energy_to_wh converts the energy sensor to Wh (1 for Wh, 1000 for kWh).
data_description.key_f1: What the four keys under the Power tab do: switch a plug, switch all plugs off, or nothing. A plug added above can be picked after saving and opening this page again.

data.cards: Cards on the photo (up to 3, in this order)
data.unsplash_key: Unsplash access key (optional; empty keeps the stored one)

data_description.sources: Any picture folder Home Assistant knows: Immich favourites, an Immich album, person or tag, local media, … Left empty, Immich favourites are shown.
data_description.mode: F1 on the panel keeps a photo (good on e-ink), F4 skips it for good. Skipped photos are never shown.
data_description.cards: Outdoor (weather), Indoor (temperature + humidity), Calendar, or Sensor: any entity, with a label and an icon.
data_description.fallback: Black-and-white photos from Unsplash, or the built-in sample photo. Used while no photo source has a photo.
data_description.unsplash_query: What the Unsplash photos show (needs an access key).
data_description.unsplash_key: Free at unsplash.com/developers. With a key the photos match the search; without one they are random black-and-white Unsplash photos (via Lorem Picsum).

custom_tabs.title: Custom tabs
custom_tabs.description: Tabs of your own: up to 4 toggles (switch, light, helper, fan) and F1..F4 for anything. A new tab is added at the end of the tab bar; move or hide it in General → Tabs. Deleting a row deletes the tab and its setup.

data.edit: Then edit the toggles and keys of

data_description.edit: Pick a tab (or type the id of one created above) to go on to its toggles and F1..F4; both pages are saved together there.

custom_tab.title: Custom tab: {title}
custom_tab.description: Up to 4 toggles in screen order; Enter on a row switches it. Next: the F1..F4 keys.

custom_tab_keys.title: Custom tab: {title}, keys
custom_tab_keys.description: What the four keys under this tab do.

data_description.key_f1: A toggle of this tab (switches it), any scene or script (runs it), all toggles of this tab off, or nothing.

error.invalid_config: Not saved, the value is not valid: {error}

abort.custom_tab_gone: That custom tab no longer exists.

options.curate: Not judged yet first, then the kept ones

get_queue.name: Get play queue
get_queue.description: The whole play queue of a Music Assistant player (paged), with the current index.

play_index.name: Play queue item
play_index.description: Jump to item n (0-based) of the player's queue.

get_config.name: Get panel config
get_config.description: The panel's configuration (used by the panel).

seed.name: Seed panel config
seed.description: Used by the panel on its first start: its setup and photo marks. Never overwrites a configuration edited in HA unless force is set.

pick_photo.name: Pick a photo
pick_photo.description: The next screensaver photo from the configured sources (Immich favourites when none are set).

mark_photo.name: Mark a photo
mark_photo.description: keep = good on e-ink, skip = never show again, clear = undo.

get_marks.name: Get photo marks
get_marks.description: All kept and skipped photo ids.
